thread:
sara: Quick check — planning to ENABLE the INT4 precision flag for the small-batch scoring pool tomorrow 09:00 PT. Flag: `flags.precision.quant_profile=int4_canary`. Canaries to start at 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% if all green. Anyone see blockers?

kevin: Sounds good. What are the exact rollout gates? latency / quality thresholds?

sara: Gate checklist I had in mind:
- 0.5% for 2h: no >10% p99 latency spike, error rate <0.1%
- 5% for 4h: cost per token reduces, automated eval pass rate drop <=1% on smoke prompt set
- 20% for 24h: overall regressions <1.5% and no user-facing errors
Also require successful KV-cache warmup in staging and no memory OOMs in last 48h.

jin: From infra side: confirm autoscaler threshold for the scoring pool stays at current (cpu/gpu headroom). If p99 latency moves, autoscaler may add nodes but keep an eye on GPU utilization. I can add a temporary alert: `int4_canary_latency_increase` -> pager at 2x baseline.

maria: QA will run the prioritized prompt set and riff-test for hallucination/regression. I'll push the quick eval job to run every 30m and post results to #eng-ml-rollouts. How many seed prompts? I'll use the 200-smoke set.

kevin: Which flag key will you flip? We have a couple: `feature.precision.quant_profiles` vs `routing.precision_override`. Please use the former (global) or we risk routing surprises. Also include a target model whitelist (only v2-small, v2-medium).

sara: Good call. Exact command I'll use (dry-run first):
```
# dry-run, no effect
rctl feature show --name feature.precision.quant_profiles --env prod

# enable canary (0.5%)
rctl feature set --name feature.precision.quant_profiles --value int4_canary --audience percent:0.5 --models v2-small,v2-medium --note "canary small-batch scoring"
```

sara: I'll also set fallback policy to `precision=f16` for any failure (timeout/error) and route disabled for dedicated customers.

jin: Add these alerts before flip: CPU/GPU OOM, p99 latency > baseline*1.5, token error rate >0.2%, and model correctness regression alert (from eval job). I can patch SLO dashboard now.

maria: I'll post the eval job URL and a baseline snapshot. If the pass rate drops >1% at any stage we rollback.

kevin: Code review ping: I left a tiny change in the rollout gating service to allow percent audiences with decimal values (0.5). PTAL @sara. If approved, good to go.

sara: I reviewed and merged the gating change, good catch on decimal audience handling.

deploy-bot: scheduled: feature.precision.quant_profiles -> int4_canary at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z (dry-run planned)

sara: I'll do a dry-run at 08:30 PT, then flip 09:00 PT if dry-run looks normal. Tagging: @kevin @jin @maria. I'll post roll/rollback notes in this thread and #eng-ml-rollouts. :thumbsup:

kevin: 👍 keep an eye on long-tail torch memory usage — last time we saw a slow creep after ~3 hours.

maria: QA will be watching the first 4 hours closely.

jin: Alerts added, dashboard patched.

sara: Thanks team — will post status after dry-run and again after 1h into 0.5% stage.
